plan.name: v1.14.0
plan.info: v1.14.0: MsgDeleteUser — users can permanently delete their account (self-signed or governance). On-chain: releases username, clears profile KV and lists, sweeps spendable balances to community pool. Indexer: soft-deletes profile (deleted_at) for post attribution; username resolution excludes deleted users. Posts from deleted users retain original author display.

title: Upgrade: v1.14.0
summary: Introduces MsgDeleteUser for account deletion — self-delete (envelope_pubkey) or governance. Clears on-chain state, sweeps funds to community pool, soft-deletes in indexer while preserving post attribution.
